notes.title: Update Notes for 11/11
notes.content:
New Features:
- Added new artwork and objects to main menu garage
- Created loading screen graphics

Bug Fixes:
- Disabled retro mode filter on takedowns and crashes.

notes.title: Update Notes for 1/5
notes.content:
[b]Additions:[/b]
- Retro Mode: Enable "Retro Mode" in the settings to add a render the game with a CRT inspired shader and have a bit more of a pixelated look
- The "Retro Mode" filter has been added to takedown and crash cameras to better emulate the look of a camera view finder
- Improved various UI elements

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Fixed the scrolling issue with the leaderboard

notes.title: Update Notes for 10/28
notes.content: - Changed vehicle behaviors' in "Hot Pursuit" mode. The mode in now balanced and not too easy.
